description: Presidential Secretariate - Appointed Hon. L. Ratwatta member of Parliament, as the State Minister of Plantation Industries and Mahaweli Development w.e.f. 29.01.2024 - Hon. L. Ratwatta, State Minister of Plantation Industries has resigned office of the State Minister w.e.f. 29.01.2024
reasoning: The gazette content specifically names an individual (Hon.
